releaseNotes: Adds The Shadow Realm for unwanted local audio without moving or deleting storage files. Long-press a song and choose Send to Shadow Realm to hide it from Songs, Albums, Artists, Liked, search, and newly built queues. Open Settings > The Shadow Realm to review hidden tracks, return individual songs to the mortal realm, or restore all. Hidden state persists across restarts and library rescans, and existing likes/metadata remain intact.
